name: japan-lost-item
description: Free Japan lost item checker: who to contact (station, Tokyo Metro, JR, taxi, airport, police), what to stop first, how long found items are kept under 遺失物法 (3 months; umbrellas and clothing 2 weeks), finder's reward and the residence card 14-day reissue deadline. Keyless JSON API + MCP.
